note: Enabled rules are shadow candidates. Execution requires code/lesson-hash-matched prospective paired portfolio evidence; historical trigger association cannot promote or suspend a rule.

crash_rebound_admit.summary: join+sector constructive but AB/peer still crash-negative: stop letting AB/peer drag the score (clip at 0) and waive the LAG-peer eligibility kill. Micro with maxed peer RS + positive AB bypasses the size gate.

join_floor_pass.summary: Peer-maxed + AB-positive (or earnings inside 7d + AB-positive): a negative join no longer vetoes the name; the rest of the score stack decides.

earnings_anti_fade.summary: Earnings inside the 1w horizon (0-7d) with top-tercile AB (>=0.6): clip negative join/news contributions at 0 so the print name is not faded.

news_attach.summary: News-dark name with strong join/AB gets the finviz-digest headline tone attached (+-0.2). Negative s_news on high-AB names with earnings inside 7d is treated as missing, not a sell veto.
